description: satisfy=one contrasted with all on OVERLAPPING windows: requests at t0 (window [0,2]) and t1 (window [1,3]); a single ack at t2 lies in both. Under 'one' only the earliest-eligible instance (t0) consumes it; instance t1 has no other ack in [1,3] and misses its deadline at t3. Under satisfy=all (case-11, identical trace) the same ack satisfies both.

events.note: t2: one shared event; discharges t0 only
t3: deadline of instance t1 passes -> deadline_missed
